name: MergeDataTables
label: Merge Data Tables
description: Merges two data tables together, specifying the merging behavior in case their columns are different.

fields.name: FirstDataTable
fields.label: First Data Table
fields.description: The first DataTable to be merged.

fields.name: SecondDataTable
fields.label: Second Data Table
fields.description: The second DataTable to be merged.

fields.name: MergeMode
fields.label: Merge Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to handle columns that are present in the second table but not in the first table.

selectOptions.label: Add Extra Columns
selectOptions.description: Adds columns from the second table that are not present in the first table.

selectOptions.label: Ignore Extra Columns
selectOptions.description: Ignores columns from the second table that are not present in the first table.

selectOptions.label: Error On Extra Columns
selectOptions.description: Throws an error if the second table has columns not present in the first table.

fields.name: MergedDataTable
fields.label: Merged Data Table
fields.description: The resulting DataTable after merging the two input Data Tables.
